Title: Owner successfully edits assignment metadata
Preconditions: 1. Owner is logged in | 2. Project exists with ID | 3. Assignment exists for the project
Steps: 1. Navigate to /projects/{projectId} | 2. Scroll to Assignment section | 3. Click "Edit Assignment" button | 4. Update Freelancer Name to "Jane Doe" | 5. Update Description to "Updated project scope and deliverables" | 6. Add Notes "Deadline extended by 2 weeks" | 7. Click "Save Changes"
Test Data: Freelancer Name: "Jane Doe" | Description: "Updated project scope and deliverables" | Notes: "Deadline extended by 2 weeks"
Expected Result: 1. Edit form closes | 2. Assignment card displays updated freelancer name "Jane Doe" | 3. Description shows "Updated project scope and deliverables" | 4. Notes section displays "Deadline extended by 2 weeks" | 5. No error messages appear

Update all fields (name, description, notes) | 12. Click "Save Changes"
Test Data: Project: "Full Workflow Test", Budget: $1000 | Bid: $500 | Updated Freelancer: "Alex Smith" | Updated Description: "Revised assignment after discussion" | Notes: "Client requested changes"

Title: Backend returns 403 when non-owner attempts API edit
Preconditions: 1. Assignment exists | 2. Bidder auth token available
Steps: 1. Obtain bidder auth token | 2. Make direct API call: PUT /api/assignments/{assignmentId} | 3. Include valid update data in body | 4. Check response
Expected Result: 1. API returns 403 Forbidden | 2. Response body contains error: "Only the project owner can update this assignment" | 3. Assignment data unchanged in database | 4. Audit log may record unauthorized attempt

Title: Edit assignment with invalid assignment ID
Steps: 1. Navigate to project details page | 2. Manually trigger API call with invalid ID "invalid-id-12345" | 3. Or intercept network and modify assignmentId before PUT
Expected Result: 1. API returns 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request | 2. Error message indicates assignment not found | 3. UI handles error gracefully | 4. User sees error message without crash

Title: Network failure during edit submission
Preconditions: 1. Owner is logged in | 2. Assignment exists | 3. Simulate network offline
Steps: 1. Navigate to project details | 2. Click "Edit Assignment" | 3. Update fields with valid data | 4. Disconnect network or block API endpoint | 5. Click "Save Changes"
Expected Result: 1. API call fails (network error) | 2. Error message displays: "Failed to update assignment" or similar | 3. Form remains open with user's changes | 4. User can retry after network restored | 5. No partial update occurs
